notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.59.0. On Windows with monitors at different scaling (say a 125% laptop beside a 100% monitor), the rack and its satellite windows now land, dock and restore where they should; satellites keep their size when dragged between those monitors; and amp no longer crashes on quit.

win.notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.59.0. On Windows with monitors at different scaling (say a 125% laptop beside a 100% monitor), the rack and its satellite windows now land, dock and restore where they should; satellites keep their size when dragged between those monitors; and amp no longer crashes on quit.

linux.notes: Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.59.0. On X11 the rack and satellite windows read back their real frame position, so docking and restoring no longer drift down by a title bar. Magnetosphere still needs WebGPU, which Linux's WebKitGTK doesn't have yet, so it stays hidden here.
